proposals.text: Test a "seconds-first hard exit" rule on historical/DEMO replay: for any Firehose position whose calibrated short-horizon model (the same gate used for entry) flips to negative predicted EV within the first 5 seconds of fill, forcibly close at second 5 if unrealized PnL ≤ 0; keep a matched control cohort using the standard exit. Falsifiable prediction: the hard-exit cohort's mean realized loss-per-losing-trade is at least 40% smaller than control across a minimum 200-trade sample, with the difference significant at p<0.05 (Mann–Whitney). The hypothesis is rejected if the reduction is <10% or not statistically significant, indicating sub-second adverse selection dominates and the rule adds no containment benefit.</arg_value:6124c78e>

question: Identify one falsifiable seconds-first loss-containment experiment from current measured evidence. Return a concrete candidate only; no code or trades.
